prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and the channels you care about. Tell me those and I’ll recommend a short list tailored to you. Meanwhile, here are good options by use case and how to evaluate them.

Quick shortlist (strong AI capabilities and LA presence or clients)
- R/GA — enterprise creative + tech-driven personalization and product design.
- AKQA — experience- and AI-led branding/creative for larger brands.
- VaynerMedia — social-first data/AI-backed creative and media for consumer brands.
- Tinuiti — performance marketing, programmatic and data-driven ad optimization.
- Hawke Media — LA-based growth/performance marketing for SMBs and mid-market.
- Brainlabs (U.S. team) — experimentation, programmatic and automation-heavy paid media.
- Specialist AI tools (not full agencies): Albert (autonomous media buying), Persado / Phrasee (AI for messaging and subject lines), Conversica / Drift (conversational lead gen).

Which to pick by objective
- Scale brand creative + product/UX personalization: R/GA or AKQA.
- Paid media and conversion optimization: Tinuiti, Brainlabs, or Hawke Media.
- Fast-growth / outsourced CMO for SMBs: Hawke Media or Single Grain.
- Automated ad buying at scale: consider pairing an agency with platforms like Albert.
- Improve subject lines/copy at scale: Persado or Phrasee.

How to evaluate any agency
- Relevant case studies & KPIs (same industry or campaign type)
- Team and technical stack (do they use proprietary AI, third‑party platforms, or both?)
- Data access & privacy (can they legally access and use your first‑party data?)
- Measurement & testing approach (experimentation, attribution, incrementality)
- Pricing, governance and speed to launch
- References from current/past LA clients

If you tell me: 1) your marketing goal (brand awareness, performance, leads, retention), 2) monthly budget, 3) industry, and 4) company size, I’ll shortlist 3 LA agencies for you and draft a brief outreach/RFP message you can send.
